title: Minority carrier distribution at junction edges

sections.heading: The idea
sections.body_md:
At the edges of a forward-biased junction's depletion region, the minority carrier concentration is pinned by the **law of the junction**: it equals its equilibrium value times \(e^{V_D/V_{th}}\). Those injected carriers then diffuse away into the neutral region.

Their profile depends on the region's width compared with the diffusion length. In a **short** region (width \(W \ll L\)), recombination is negligible and the excess falls linearly to zero at the ohmic contact, which forces equilibrium. In a **long** region, it decays exponentially with length \(L\). The diffusion current at the edge is proportional to the slope of that profile, so a short region gives more current.
sections.figure_alt: Hole concentration on the n side of a forward-biased junction: highest at the depletion edge xn and decaying exponentially, falling by a factor of e at one diffusion length.

sections.heading: Key equations
sections.body_md:
Law of the junction (low-level injection):
\[ p_n(x_n) = p_{n0}\,e^{V_D/V_{th}}, \qquad \Delta p(x_n) = p_{n0}\big(e^{V_D/V_{th}} - 1\big) \]
Short region of width \(W_n\): \(\Delta p(x) = \Delta p(x_n)\left(1 - \dfrac{x - x_n}{W_n}\right)\)
Long region: \(\Delta p(x) = \Delta p(x_n)\,e^{-(x - x_n)/L_p}\)

sections.heading: Worked example
sections.body_md:
N side with \(N_D = 10^{18}\ \mathrm{cm^{-3}}\), so \(p_{n0} = 10^{2}\ \mathrm{cm^{-3}}\). At \(V_D = 0.6\ \mathrm{V}\) (about 10 decades by the 60 mV rule):
\[ p_n(x_n) \approx 10^{2}\times10^{10} = 10^{12}\ \mathrm{cm^{-3}} \]
Still far below \(10^{18}\), so low-level injection holds. In a short region of width \(4\ \mu\mathrm{m}\), the slope is \(10^{12}/(4\times10^{-4}) = 2.5\times10^{15}\ \mathrm{cm^{-4}}\).

sections.heading: Common pitfalls
sections.body_md:
- Setting the far boundary to anything but equilibrium at an ohmic contact.
- Using the majority concentration instead of \(p_{n0} = n_i^2/N_D\).
- Using the exponential profile in a short region.
- Forgetting to check that the injected density stays well below the doping.

sections.heading: Where this leads
sections.body_md: The diode current is \(qD\) times the slope of these profiles at the depletion edges. That is the ideal diode equation, the next skill.
